Analysis

Era 3 of 8

1975 to 1987: Late Cold War

Opened by: End of the Portuguese empire, wars in Southern Africa and Lebanon.

The "aggression" era: the word appears in 14% of resolutions, most of them about South Africa. Apartheid appears in 8%. The US becomes the main veto caster (50), with the UK (17) and France (11).

240resolutions
18per year
56%adopted unanimously
57vetoed drafts
1%under Chapter VII

Where the Council looked

Region of the situationShare
Africa28%
Middle East33%
Europe13%
Asia4%
Americas1%
Thematic0%
Institutional15%
Other5%

What rose in the texts

Subjects whose share of resolutions grew by 5 points or more on the previous era.

  • Elections: 1% to 8%
  • Refugees and displacement: 2% to 8%
  • Apartheid: 3% to 8%

Vetoes

57 vetoed drafts. No votes by permanent members on them: USSR / Russia 6, United States 50, United Kingdom 17, France 11. 1 further drafts failed for lack of votes.
